description: React component 'EmojiManager' providing UI for managing emojis, including display, search, upload, and delete functionalities. The component interacts with external API services for data fetching and modifications.

methods.name: normalizeList
methods.description: Normalizes raw emoji list into a consistent structure for rendering.

methods.name: seedCount
methods.description: Generates a usage count seed based on emoji properties for visual parity.

methods.name: ensureCounts
methods.description: Ensures emoji usage counts are current and synchronized with the list.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches emojis from the API, normalizes them, and updates state.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Opens the modal for adding a new emoji.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the upload of a new emoji with a name and image file.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Deletes an emoji, either text or image, via API calls.
